screen.deepcrate.sort.name: Sort A to Z
screen.deepcrate.config.title: DeepCrate settings
deepcrate.option.base_capacity.desc: How many items one slot holds in a crate carrying no capacity module. From 1 to 32767, 64 by default, which is what the rest of the game holds.
deepcrate.option.limit_automation_with_l: While Lithium is installed, a crate answers 64 per slot to hoppers and pipes. Lithium brings its own hopper, and against a slot that answers more it takes the items out and never writes them in. Turn this off and automation sees the whole slot, at the price of those items.
deepcrate.option.max_rows_per_page.desc: Rows drawn on one page before the screen cuts the crate into several. From 1 to 6, 4 by default.
How many row modules one cell accepts, which is also the stack limit of the item. From 1 to 20, 16 by default.
deepcrate.option.abbreviate_above.desc: Past this count a slot shows 2k rather than 2048, and the tooltip keeps the exact number. From 999 to 2147483647, 999 by default. It is read on the machine drawing the screen rather than on the server.
deepcrate.notice.config_problems: %s problem(s) in the structure of config/oas/deepcrate.json:
deepcrate.notice.unknown_ambiguous: '%s': did you mean '%s'? Too ambiguous to repair on its own.
deepcrate.notice.duplicated: '%s' is written in two categories, only one copy is read.
